title: Miami Dolphins release WR Tyreek Hill, making him a free agent for the first time

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Miami Dolphins release WR Tyreek Hill, making him a free agent for the first time
sources.description: The Miami Dolphins are releasing wide receiver Tyreek Hill, who will become an unrestricted free agent for the first time in his career. He's currently recovering from a dislocated knee and torn ACL.
